scope: Real Chromium, production runtime UI, routes, control service and protected config-store logic. Synthetic DB, auth source and process lifecycle; no live ioBroker controller or physical devices.

checks.name: five hosted controls; parent and external OCPP remain read-only; unconfigured modules link to setup
production mutation route rejects missing CSRF without touching lifecycle
disable persists desired state; accepted job stays busy until confirmed stop; no early stopped badge
disabled choice survives page reload and a fresh production config-service read
enable waits for lifecycle readiness and displays green only after confirmed running state
restart uses confirmed stop before start through the production control service
migration blocks starts with explanation and status link while stop remains available
stale revision fails without lifecycle change and refreshes current controls
unconfirmed stop remains visibly unconfirmed and never claims successful deactivation
UI/EMS pause remains controllable from parent runtime page and can be reactivated
missing command response is reported as unconfirmed; no automatic command replay
mobile 390px has usable buttons without horizontal overflow
lost administrator role denies mutation and removes all actionable status
